proof.text: Work first on the finite filtered complexes on the small étale sites, then transport the construction through the exact finite étale/pro-étale comparison. The filtered category, its forgetful functor, graded pieces and filtration truncations are those of [def-trf-bounded-filtered-derived-category]. By [lem-trf-filtered-operations-hom], all ordinary and exceptional adjunctions, evaluation, composition, base-change and internal-Hom transformations used below have filtered lifts, and forgetting filtration recovers the ordinary transformations. The finite constructible hypotheses and the exceptional admissibility assumptions in the statement therefore put every object and operation used in the two composites in its stated domain.

For independent filtered objects $P,Q$, apply [lem-trf-filtered-pre-evaluation]. It supplies the filtered natural transformation $T^{\prime\prime F}_{P,Q}$ from filtered global derived Hom to filtered sections on the fixed scheme, with the exceptional-Hom exchange, inverse Künneth comparison, diagonal unit, fixed-square base change and signed tensor symmetry in its defining composite. Its underlying transformation after forgetting filtration is exactly the ordinary $T^{\prime\prime}_{P,Q}$, and the construction is natural in both variables. This is the filtered lift called $\operatorname{Tr}^{\prime\prime}_{\widetilde F}$ in the source.

proof.text: Specialize $P=Q=\widetilde K$ and compose $T^{\prime\prime F}_{\widetilde K,\widetilde K}$ with the filtered evaluation $D_X^F\widetilde K\otimes_A^L\widetilde K\to\omega_{X,A}$, with $\omega_{X,A}$ in filtration degree zero. Compose also with the filtered lift of $\gamma:Rd^!\omega_{X,A}\simeq\omega_{F,A}$ from [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition], supplied by [lem-trf-filtered-operations-hom]. The result is the stated filtered map $\widetilde\tau'$ with target $R\Gamma^F(F,\omega_{F,A})$, hence with the notation $[0]_{\mathrm{fil}}$ used in the statement. By the underlying-transformation clause of [lem-trf-filtered-pre-evaluation] and the filtered-lift compatibility of [lem-trf-filtered-operations-hom], forgetting filtration gives the ordinary pre-evaluation followed by ordinary evaluation.

proof.text:
Put $B=K\boxtimes_A^LD_XK$ and let $s_B:L\Delta^*B\simeq D_XK\otimes_A^LK$ be diagonal restriction followed by signed symmetry. Both cited composites start with the same $\xi$, by [thm-trf-verdier-duality] and [lem-trf-filtered-pre-evaluation]. Set $e'=\operatorname{ev}_K\circ s_B$. The ordinary adjunction transpose in [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality] is $e_K=R\Delta_*e'\circ\eta_B$. Write $\beta_N:Rc^!R\Delta_*N\to Ri_*Rd^!N$ for its fixed-square exchange. Naturality at $e':L\Delta^*B\to\omega_{X,A}$ gives
$$\beta_{\omega_X}\circ Rc^!R\Delta_*e'=Ri_*Rd^!e'\circ\beta_{L\Delta^*B}.$$
Consequently
$$\beta_{\omega_X}\circ Rc^!e_K=Ri_*Rd^!e'\circ\beta_{L\Delta^*B}\circ Rc^!\eta_B.$$
The right side is precisely the pre-evaluation composite followed by $Rd^!\operatorname{ev}_K$, since $e'=\operatorname{ev}_K\circ s_B$. The left side is precisely the external-duality trace composite before the common final dualizing isomorphism $\gamma$ of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition]. Apply $R\Gamma$, its common direct-image compositor, and $\gamma$ to obtain (a)=(b). This uses the same signed symmetry once on each side, so introduces no additional sign.

proof.text: For any $\widetilde K\in D^bF_{ctf}(X,A)$, the same specialization is defined before forgetting filtration, so it gives $\widetilde\tau':R\operatorname{Hom}^F_X(G\widetilde K,\widetilde K)\to R\Gamma^F(F,\omega_{F,A})$. Since the target is concentrated in filtration degree zero, its underlying filtered object is exactly $R\Gamma(F,\omega_{F,A})[0]_{\mathrm{fil}}$. The global filtered-Hom formula and its forgetful comparison in [lem-trf-filtered-operations-hom] show that the underlying map is the ordinary composite of step 3. Therefore it is (a), and by step 4 it is (b) for $K=\omega\widetilde K$. The filtration index is placed only on the target object; no cochain shift is introduced.

title: Filtered pre-evaluation identifies the Verdier trace map
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $n\ge1$, and $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $X,C$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $c=(c_1,c_2):C\to X\times_sX$ an admissible correspondence of [def-trf-correspondence], and $F=\operatorname{Fix}(c)$ with maps $i:F\to C$, $d:F\to X$ as in [def-trf-fixed-scheme]. Assume exceptional admissibility in the sense of [def-trf-admissibility] for $c$, the two product projections, the diagonal, $i,d$, and the structure maps of $X,F$. Put $G=Rc_{1!}c_2^*$. Work with the finite filtered categories of [def-trf-bounded-filtered-derived-category] and the filtered operations of [lem-trf-filtered-operations-hom], constructed on the small étale sites and transported to the pro-étale coefficient categories. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. Under the exceptional-adjunction isomorphism
$$R\operatorname{Hom}_X(GK,K)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(C,R\mathcal Hom_A(c_2^*K,c_1^!K)),$$
the following two maps agree: (a) the canonical pre-evaluation map $T''_{K,K}$ of [lem-trf-filtered-pre-evaluation], followed by $R\Gamma(F,Rd^!\operatorname{ev}_K)$ and the dualizing composition isomorphism of [thm-trf-dualizing-complex-composition], $Rd^!\omega_{X,A}\simeq\omega_{F,A}$; (b) the external-duality trace map $\mathfrak t_{c,K}$ of [lem-trf-trace-map-from-external-duality]. Evaluation has the convention $D_XK\otimes_A^LK\to\omega_{X,A}$ of [def-trf-dualizing-complex]. In this equality the comparison $R\mathcal Hom(c_2^*K,c_1^!K)\simeq Rc^!(K\boxtimes_A^LD_XK)$ obtained from exceptional-Hom exchange and inverse Künneth is the external-duality comparison $\xi$ of [thm-trf-verdier-duality]; the diagonal transpose used by $\mathfrak t$ is $e_K=R\Delta_*(e')\circ\eta_{K\boxtimes D_XK}$, where $e'$ is diagonal pullback, signed symmetry and evaluation. For any $\widetilde K\in D^bF_{ctf}(X,A)$, specializing $T''^F$ to $(\widetilde K,\widetilde K)$ and composing with filtered evaluation and dualizing composition therefore gives a map
$$\widetilde\tau':R\operatorname{Hom}^F_X(G\widetilde K,\widetilde K)\to R\Gamma(F,\omega_{F,A})[0]_{\mathrm{fil}},$$
whose underlying map is (a), hence (b), for $K=\omega\widetilde K$. The notation $[0]_{\mathrm{fil}}$ places the target in filtration degree zero and does not shift its cochain degree.
